description: Check where a quote or callback request stands, using the reference code (VR-XXXXXX) from submit_quote_request or request_callback and the last 4 digits of the phone number given with it. Returns the stage only (received, contacting, quoting, quote ready, sold, closed). No personal details are returned.

phone_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the phone number used on the request

name: get_quote_status
title: Check a quote request
